<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.TopIndex: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Calculates the topographic index, ln(a/tan β), the natural logarithm of the contributing area over the slope: the higher it is, the more the cell tends to saturate. It depends only on the morphology. It is not defined where the slope is 0, which is left as no-data.

**Toolbox folder:** Basin<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Topographic index, Saturation, Hydrology<br>
**Authors:** Daniele Andreis, Antonello Andrea, Erica Ghesla, Cozzini Andrea, Franceschi Silvia, Pisoni Silvano, Rigon Riccardo<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.TopIndex`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inTca` | raster file | cells |  | The map of the total contributing area, in cells. |
| `inSlope` | raster file | m/m |  | The map of the slope along the drainage directions, as the tangent of the slope angle. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outTopindex` | output file |  | The map of the topographic index. |

**References**

- Beven, K. J., Kirkby, M. J. (1979). A physically based, variable contributing area model of basin hydrology. Hydrological Sciences Bulletin, 24(1), 43-69.
